description: Adaptive Framework configuration component for type=adapter adapterType=model. A model adapter loads an _AdaptiveModel_ from modelLocationAdapterId/modelId and exposes it as an adapter. It can map-and-forward to another adapter (hybrid) via mappedAdapterId, and/or fully implement operations in model object-type on* Adaptive Scripts (pure-script). Pure-script models that implement every used operation in on* may omit mappedAdapterId.

custom.brief: Qualifier custom:: variables available to model expressions
custom.description: Qualifier custom:: variables available to model expressions.
custom.label: Custom

mappedAdapterId.brief: Optional default backend adapter for map-and-forward
mappedAdapterId.description: Adapter id used as the default backend for map-and-forward (default get/retrieve/add/modify/replace/delete, transactions, model_default_* actions, and when an on* hook returns current::useDefaultProcessing). Also exposed as current::mappedAdapterId in model scripts. Optional: pure-script models that implement every used operation in on* hooks may omit this property. When set, it must not equal this model adapter's own adapterId. If omitted and default processing is needed for an operation, an error is thrown.
mappedAdapterId.label: Mapped Adapter

modelId.brief: The objectId of the _AdaptiveModel_ object in the modelLocationAdapterId adapter
modelId.description: The objectId of the _AdaptiveModel_ object in the modelLocationAdapterId adapter. Required for both hybrid and pure-script model adapters; the model definition (object types and on* scripts) is always loaded from this location.
modelId.label: Model

modelLocationAdapterId.brief: This is the id of the adapter that contains object type _AdaptiveModel_ and related objects
modelLocationAdapterId.description: This is the id of the adapter that contains object type _AdaptiveModel_ and related objects. That adapter must be configured with isModelLocation=true. Required for both hybrid and pure-script model adapters.
modelLocationAdapterId.label: Model Adapter
